claim: An index that looks free for transparency may be a painted colour: reserve an exact duplicate, remap only at the final copy, keep source masks untouched, and reset the ULA bright-black entry when transparency changes.

evidence.text: Index 255 is painted white, not free transparency: duplicate index 71 reserved for transparency, painted 71 mapped to 63 only at the final display copy, ULA bright-black entry 24 reset to black.
